custom_logic_notes: X2 logic: The EA uses TWO independent SineWave indicator channels with different periods (Periods1 and Periods2). Either channel can generate entry signals independently. When an opposite signal fires on either channel, the existing position is closed first before a new position is opened. The SineWave custom indicator has two buffers (0 and 1) whose crossover/crossunder generates signals. The EA also features a TimeFrame input allowing multi-timeframe analysis where indicators are calculated on a different timeframe than the chart.
python_conversion_notes: Requires implementation of the SineWave custom indicator algorithm in Python since it is not a built-in MT5 indicator. The X2 dual-channel logic means both SineWave instances with different periods must be computed and their crossover signals combined with OR logic for entry. Digit adjustment for 5-digit brokers must be handled. The conditional money management (negative=fixed lots, positive=risk fraction) needs careful implementation. Trailing stop logic uses standard point-based trailing. Multi-timeframe support requires resampling bar data to the target timeframe before indicator calculation.
